caption:
A new New York Fed study looked at who got credit cards. 📊

The median score at card issuance dipped from 699 (2017-19) to 688 (2020-22). It has since moved back above pre-pandemic levels.

Cards opened since early 2023 have mostly gone to higher-score borrowers.

Were cards easier or harder to get for you lately?
